## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

SDPA FROST forward, THD (packed) native binder

## Summary

Fixes #1482.

A single-request (`b == 1`) THD graph can declare head-major Stats `(1, H_q, S_q, 1)` over a `[H_q, t_q]` buffer, with `S_q` below the packed-Q capacity `t_q`. Such a graph passed `check_support` and `build_plans`. Then the first `execute` raised `ValueError: cudnn.sdpa: head-major lse_tensor logical shape must cover bounded packed Q`, and at that point the plan walk has no fallback (Rule 2).

The native THD binder (`python/pygraph/sdpa_thd_binding.cpp`) checked the declaration's logical rows against the packed-Q capacity. The kernel writes at most `b * S_q` live rows (`seq_len_q <= S_q`). So the logical bound is now `min(capacity, b * S_q)`; this is option 2 in the issue. The storage checks are unchanged: the observed span must still hold `H_q * head_stride`.

- The Python binding oracle (`test/python/sdpa/frost/sdpa_binding_reference.py`) applies the same bound.
- The cc 10.7 detector `test_sdpa_paged_thd_sink_head_major_batch_one_cc107_L0` changes from strict xfail to a must-serve cell.
  - It has an SM100 twin, `test_sdpa_thd_head_major_batch_one_frost_L0[paged|nonpaged x sink|no_sink]`.
  - `_p2_cfg` gains a trailing `paged=True` kwarg so the twin can build the nonpaged case.
- The cc 10.7 P2 sweep keeps `b == 1` head-major draws head-major; it no longer rewrites them to token-major.
- `SUPPORT_MATRIX_TRACKER.md`: the Gaps row is removed, and the P2 validation paragraph is updated.

## Testing

On B200 (cc 10.0) with cuDNN 9.27 and `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1` where FROST routing is asserted:

| Run | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| The issue's repro dict on `sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100` (d256 64/8, b 1, s_q 5, len 4), paged and nonpaged × sink on and off | 4/4 raise the `ValueError` | 4/4 pass, O and Stats checked against the reference |
| `test_mhas_v2.py -k head_major_batch_one` (new SM100 cells; the cc 10.7 cells skip) | — | 4 passed |
| Native THD / prepared / geometry / ragged-decode binding suites, including the differential oracle tests | — | 1062 passed, 96 skipped |
| `sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_dsl_sm100.py` | — | 1116 passed, 8 skipped |
| `test_mhas_v2.py -k "thd or ragged or paged"`, all levels | — | 2393 passed, 121 skipped |

Not run locally: the cc 10.7 cells, because I have no SM107 device. They go through the same binder change.
